name: breastfeeding_timer
description: Start, switch, pause, resume, end or cancel the active breastfeeding session, or check its status. Use action start with side (left or right) to begin. switch changes side: pass side, or omit it to toggle to the other side. pause and resume stop and restart the clock. end saves the finished session; cancel discards it. status reports the active session or says there is none. Only one session can be active at a time; starting another fails until the current one is ended or cancelled.

action.description: Required. One of: start, switch, pause, resume, end, cancel, status.

side.description: The side for this action: left or right. Required for start. Optional for switch: omit it to switch to the other side. Do not pass it for pause, resume, end, cancel or status.
